0022600104.text: The Miami Heat (0-1, 15th in the East, fifth in the Southeast, one game back) visit the Charlotte Hornets (1-0, third in the Southeast, sixth in the East) in what is Miami's third game of the season. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), all listed as out, while Miami has no listed absences. The teams have not met yet this season, and Miami won the 2025-26 series 3-1, though the most recent meeting went Charlotte's way, 136-106 on March 17, 2026.
